description: This Kotlin source file defines a mock backend interceptor for unit testing or demo purposes. It intercepts HTTP requests and simulates server responses for authentication and protected resource access, enabling the app to run without a real server.

classes.name: MockBackendInterceptor
classes.description: A class implementing an OkHttp Interceptor that provides mock responses for authentication and protected resource endpoints to facilitate offline demo or testing.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests, checks the request method and path, and returns appropriate mock responses based on the endpoint.

methods.name: issueTokens
methods.description: Generates new access and refresh tokens with expiry time, updates shared server state.

methods.name: readUtf8Body
methods.description: Reads and returns the request body as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: parseJsonField
methods.description: Parses a simple JSON string to extract a specific field's value.

methods.name: tokenResponseJson
methods.description: Formats a TokenResponse object into a JSON string.

methods.name: jsonResponse
methods.description: Constructs an OkHttp Response object from status code and JSON body.
